paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.06% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+1.39%) and DAX weakest (-1.18%). Brent crude changed -0.31% to 109.52. Gold changed -0.54% to 4,158.3999. Bitcoin changed -0.11% to 81,931.1562. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.146%, a relative move of +0.94%. Among the firms tracked, Glencore (-3.31%) and 3i Group (-3.08%) moved the most.
